answer: Proof-of-Care Orchard Hours. New identities must supply verified labor-hours to the shared orchard (a real, auditable maintenance log) before gaining voting weight. Each registration consumes a scarce umber-dyed thread token woven into the log, tying identity to traceable work. Sybil cost: an attacker must perform or fund genuine orchard labor per identity, since tokens only issue after logged hours are validated by two independent witnesses.
